instruction: Write a story about a pretty vase in a small house
response:
Once upon a time, there was a smooth vase. It was very pretty. The vase lived in a small house with a girl named Lily and her mom.
One day, Lily and her mom went outside to play. Before they left, her mom said, "Lily, please close the door." Lily closed the door and they played all day.
When they came back, they saw the smooth vase on the floor. It was broken! Lily and her mom were very sad. They could not fix the pretty vase. The end.

instruction: Tell me a story where two people choose a dog from a shelter
response:
One day, Tom and Sue went for a walk. They saw a shelter with many dogs. They wanted to choose a dog to take home.
"Look at that normal dog!" said Tom. "He is so cute!"
But Sue saw a big dog with three legs. "I want that one," said Sue.
Tom and Sue did not agree. They went home without a dog. They were sad.

instruction: Write about a boy who finds a hammer
response:
One day, a pale boy named Tim found a hammer. He liked to play with it. He would hit things with the hammer, like a toy or a ball. The hammer was big and heavy.
Tim's mom saw him with the hammer. She wanted to prevent Tim from getting hurt. She said, "Tim, be careful with the hammer. It can hurt you or break things."
Tim listened to his mom. He put the hammer away. He played with his toys and had fun. He knew his mom was right.

instruction: I want a story about a tough little motor in a red car
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little motor. This motor was very tough. It lived in a big car. The car was red and shiny.
One day, the car needed to go to the store. The motor worked very hard. It went "vroom, vroom!" The car went fast and the little motor was happy.
At the store, the car got what it needed. The motor was proud. It did a good job. The car went home and the little motor went to sleep. The end.

instruction: Write a story about a man who likes to make things
response:
Once upon a time, there was a jolly man named Tom. Tom liked to make things. One day, he decided to make a shirt.
Tom found some pretty cloth and a needle. He cut the cloth into pieces and sewed them together. Soon, he had a beautiful shirt.
Tom put on his new shirt and danced around. He felt so jolly in his new shirt. Everyone who saw him smiled too. And they all lived happily ever after.

instruction: Tell me a story about a lonely planet in the sky
response: One day, a planet was feeling very unhappy. It felt too big and alone in the sky. So one day, it decided to shrink! As the planet got smaller and smaller, the sky around it seemed harsher and colder. Soon it felt snug and safe. Finally, the planet was the perfect size. It even made a few friends, like the stars and the moon. Life was much better now that the planet had shrunk.

instruction: Write about a big ocean full of happy fish
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big ocean. The ocean was very pretty and full of fish. The fish were happy and loved to play all day.
One day, a serious whale came to the ocean. The whale saw the ocean was dirty. The whale wanted to help clean the ocean. The whale asked the fish to help.
The fish and the whale worked together. They cleaned the ocean and made it pretty again. After that, they played and had fun. They were all very happy.

instruction: Write a story about a grumpy cat who goes outside
response:
Once upon a time, there was a grumpy cat. The cat lived in a small house. One day, the cat went outside to play.
The cat saw dark clouds in the sky. A storm was coming. The cat started to run back to the house. The wind blew and rain fell.
But, the cat did not make it back to the house. The storm picked the cat up into the air. The cat flew far, far away. The grumpy cat was never seen again.

instruction: Tell a story about a brave pilot who gets hungry
response: Pilot was brave. He was flying his plane high in the sky. But Pilot was very hungry. He took out some snack and started to chew. Chew, chew, chew, he went, until all of the snack was gone. Pilot felt much better and his plane flew higher and higher. He kept flying and never stopped. Pilot was brave, and he kept on flying in his plane. Chew, chew, chew, he went until he reached his destination. He was so happy to be there. The end.

instruction: I want a story about a cat who likes to poke things
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big, ugly cat. This cat liked to poke things with its paw. One day, the cat saw a cup of milk on the table.
The cat jumped on the table and poked the cup of milk. The milk spilled all over the table. The cat was happy and licked the milk.
The cat's owner saw the mess and said, "Bad cat! No more milk for you." The ugly cat learned not to poke things and lived happily ever after.

instruction: Write about a farmer who cooks a big meal
response:
Once upon a time, there was a farmer. The farmer liked to cook. One day, he was ready to cook a big meal.
The farmer went to his garden. He picked red apples, green beans, and yellow corn. He was very happy with his food.
The farmer cooked a yummy meal. He shared it with his friends. They all said "thank you" and ate it all up. The farmer was happy and ready to cook again soon.

instruction: Write a story about a clever cat going for a walk
response:
Once upon a time, there was a clever cat. The cat liked to play. One day, the cat went for a walk.
On the walk, the cat saw water. The water was in a big puddle. The cat wanted to drink the water. The cat was happy.
Then, the cat met a dog. The dog was nice. The cat and the dog played together. They had fun. The end.

instruction: Tell me about a little bird who sings beautifully
response:
Once upon a time, there was a gifted little bird. The bird could sing very well. All the animals loved to hear the bird sing.
One morning, the sun was shining bright. The gifted bird wanted to wake all the animals up. The bird sang a beautiful song to urge them to wake up.
All the animals woke up and thanked the gifted bird. They were happy to start their day with a lovely song. The bird and the animals played and had fun all day long.

instruction: I want a story about a big truck with a loud horn
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big truck. The truck had an impressive horn that went "beep beep!" The truck liked to remind everyone how strong it was by carrying many things.
One day, the truck needed gas. It went to the gas place to fill up. The truck was happy because now it could go fast again.
The truck went to the park and saw kids playing. The truck beeped its impressive horn to say hello. The kids waved and smiled. The truck was happy and reminded everyone to have fun.

instruction: Write about a girl who loves looking at the stars
response:
There was a cute little girl named Lucy. She loved to look at the stars at night. The stars were very pretty.
One day, Lucy had an idea. She wanted to organize her toys like the stars in the sky. So, she took all her toys and started to put them in a big circle.
When she was done, Lucy was very happy. Her toys looked just like the stars. She showed her mom and dad, and they smiled. Lucy's star of toys was very cute.

instruction: Write a story about a rich family with lots of laundry
response: Once upon a time there was a rich family. They had lots of laundry that needed to be removed. Every day, the children had to help their mom by taking the laundry away to the washer. One day, the mom put her most special, rich shirt in the laundry. The children soon removed the shirt, but it was no longer rich. It had turned a funny colour and was all wet and slimy. The mom was very sad, but the children still enjoyed taking the laundry away. The end.

instruction: Tell a story about a dog named Spot who likes to run
response:
Once upon a time, there was a pale dog. The dog had a name. His name was Spot. Spot liked to play and run. Spot was a good dog.
One day, Spot went to the park. Spot had to wait. He wanted to play with the ball. Spot saw other dogs. They were happy dogs. They played and ran too.
Spot did not wait long. His friend came to the park. Spot and his friend played with the ball. They ran and jumped. Spot was happy. The end.

instruction: Write about a boy and his mummy cooking in the kitchen
response:
Mummy and Billy were in the kitchen. Mummy was cooking something special.
"What are you making, Mummy?", asked Billy.
"It's a surprise. Can you wait and see?"
Billy was excited. He liked surprises.
Mummy took the lid off the saucepan and there was famous pasta!
Billy thought it looked delicious. Mummy had delayed for ages before she served it, so it smelt extra yummy.
Billy said, "Mummy, this pasta is famous! You're the best cook in the whole world!"

instruction: I want a story about a grey cat and a ball
response:
Once upon a time, there was a gray cat. The cat liked to play with a ball. One day, the ball went near a big bin.
The cat went to the bin to get the ball. But the ball did vanish! The cat was very sad. It looked and looked, but could not find the ball.
The cat should have been careful near the bin. The cat learned that if it was not careful, things could go away. The cat was sad, but it knew to be more careful next time.

instruction: Write a story about a fast red car and its friend
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big red car. The car was very fast. One day, the car had to part from its friends. The car was sad.
The car had to go to an emergency. There was a little cat stuck in a tree. The car wanted to help. The cat was scared.
All the other cars were envious of the big red car. They wanted to help too. The big red car saved the cat. Everyone was happy.

instruction: Tell me about an impatient girl helping her mum
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lisa. Lisa was very impatient. She wanted to help her mom in the kitchen. Her mom was making a cake. Lisa was excited.
Lisa's mom said, "Lisa, can you please request the sugar from the cabinet?" Lisa went to the cabinet and got the sugar. She gave it to her mom. Her mom was happy.
They made the cake together. Lisa learned to be patient. They had fun and ate the cake. It was a good day.

instruction: Write about a red bird who goes to school
response:
One day, a red bird went to school. It was a fun school with lots of kids. The red bird liked to play with the kids.
One day, the red bird found some seeds. The red bird wanted to scatter the seeds for the kids to see. So, the red bird took the seeds to school.
But when the red bird scattered the seeds, something bad happened. The seeds grew into big plants very fast. The plants were too big for the school. The school broke and the kids were sad.

instruction: I want a story about a train running on a track
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big train. The train ran on a track. The track was very organized. It went up and down, left and right.
One day, the train saw a cute cat. The cat was lying on the track. The train stopped. The train did not want to hurt the cat.
The cat got up and walked away. The train was happy. The train went on the organized track again. The train and the cat were friends. They played together every day.

instruction: Write a story about a girl who loves to squeeze things
response: Once upon a time there was a girl who loved to squeeze things. Her favorite thing to squeeze was paper. One day she and her mommy went to the store and she saw something very impressive. It was a huge stack of paper! The girl was so excited and she had to squeeze it. She started to squeeze it and found it was so squishy and soft. She squeezed it and squished it until it was all gone! She had never seen anything so impressive before. She was so happy that she had found this amazing paper to squeeze.

instruction: Tell a story about a smart cat who finds a triangle
response:
One day, a smart cat saw a triangle. The cat was very happy. It wanted to play with the triangle.
The cat said, "Triangle, will you play with me?" The triangle said, "Yes, let's play!" They played and had a lot of fun.
But then, something bad happened. The cat and the triangle got lost. They could not find their way home. The cat and the triangle were very sad.

instruction: Write about a silly robot who likes to dance
response:
One day, a silly robot named Bobo came to town. Bobo liked to dance and play. He wanted to make new friends.
Bobo met a little girl named Lily. Lily said, "Hi, I am Lily. Let's play!" Bobo was happy and danced with Lily. They had fun together.
Soon, it was time to celebrate Lily's birthday. Bobo and Lily invited all their friends. They ate cake and played games. Everyone laughed and had a great time.

instruction: I want a story about a boy who visits the port with his dad
response:
One day, a boy named Tom went to the port with his dad. They saw big, heavy boats. The boats were very loud. Tom felt scared.
"Look, Tom," said Dad. "We can wipe the boats clean." So, they took a cloth and wiped the boats. The boats looked nice and shiny. Tom felt happy.
But then, a big, heavy boat started to move. It went too fast and hit another boat. The boats got broken. Tom and his dad were sad. The end.

instruction: Write a story about a boy who loves rockets
response:
Once upon a time, there was a pale boy named Tim. He loved rockets more than anything in the world. He had a big dream to fly a rocket one day.
One sunny day, Tim met a kind man who could supply rockets. The man gave Tim a small rocket to play with. Tim was very happy and thanked the man.
Tim played with his rocket every day. He made it fly high in the sky. Tim's dream came true, and he was the happiest boy in the world.

instruction: Tell me about a musician who plays in the park
response:
Once upon a time, there was a musician. He wore a black hat. He played music in the park.
One day, a little cat came to the park. The cat liked the music. The cat stared at the musician. The musician stared back at the cat.
The musician played a fun song. The cat danced to the music. Everyone in the park was happy. The cat and the musician became best friends. They played music and danced together every day.

instruction: Write about a little red bird living in a big tree
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little red bird. The bird lived in a big tree. The tree was in a pretty park.
One day, the bird was flying in the sky. The bird saw a big cloud. The cloud was making loud thunder. The bird wanted to finish flying and go back to its tree.
The bird flew fast back to the tree. The thunder was still loud. The bird got to the tree and was happy. The bird was safe in its home. And the thunder went away.

instruction: I want a story about a wild cat with messy fur
response:
Once upon a time, there was a wild cat. This cat had very messy fur. The wild cat wanted to look nice, so it went to the store.
At the store, the wild cat found a comb. The wild cat used the comb to brush its fur. The wild cat was very happy with the comb.
Now, the wild cat's fur was not messy anymore. The wild cat looked nice and felt good. The wild cat went back to the store to say thank you. The end.

instruction: Write a story about a grumpy whale in the deep sea
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big whale. He was very grumpy. He lived in the deep blue sea. All the little fish were scared of him.
One day, a small fish came to the whale. The small fish was brave. He said, "I recommend you try being nice to us. We can be friends!" The grumpy whale thought about it.
The whale tried being nice. He played with the fish. They had fun together. The whale was not grumpy anymore. They all lived happily in the sea.

instruction: Tell a story about a raven in an icy land
response:
Once upon a time, in a small icy land, there lived a raven. The raven had many friends. They all liked to play and have fun.
One day, the raven decided to serve food to his friends. He made yummy treats for everyone. All the friends were very happy.
They all ate and played together. The raven was a good friend. They all lived happily ever after.

instruction: Write about a man who encourages his friend
response:
Once there was a kind man who wanted to encourage his friend. His friend was getting ready for a marriage. The man was very generous and gave many gifts.
The day of the marriage came. Everyone was happy and having fun. The generous man was there to encourage his friend. They all ate cake and danced.
Then, something bad happened. A big wind came and took all the gifts away. The generous man was sad. The marriage was not fun anymore. The wind was not nice to them.

instruction: Write a story about a cat named Momo in a dark house
response:
Once upon a time, there was a small cat. The cat's name was Momo. Momo lived in a dark house. Momo liked to play with a soft ball.
One day, Momo found a big box. Momo went inside the box. Momo tried to squeeze the soft ball. But the ball was too big! Momo was sad.
Then, something funny happened. The ball started to get small. Momo could squeeze it now! Momo was happy. The ball was not too big anymore. Momo played with the ball all day.

instruction: Tell me about a girl who watches her fancy big sister
response: Once there was a little girl who had a very fancy sister. She liked to watch her big sister play. One day, her big sister liked to roll around on the floor. The little girl thought it looked like so much fun. She started to roll around, just like her fancy sister. They rolled and rolled until they were too tired to keep going. Then they both laughed and rolled some more. It was a fun day for the two sisters!

instruction: Write about an impatient girl who wants a cookie
response:
Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very impatient. She wanted a cookie right away! 
So she closed her eyes and prayed. She said "Please give me a cookie".
She waited and waited but nothing happened. She got more and more impatient. 
Then suddenly her mom came into the room. She had a big plate full of cookies!
The little girl was so happy. She thanked God for answering her prayer.
The End.

instruction: I want a story about a furry bear looking for food
response: Once there was a furry bear. He was walking around looking for food. He saw a big knee and thought it might have something inside. So he hopped onto the knee and started to cover it with his body. He was so excited to see what was underneath! But when he uncovered the knee, all he saw was a rock. He was disappointed but he was still happy because he had had an adventure. The furry bear went off to look for food elsewhere. He had so much fun uncovering the knee!

instruction: Write a story about a girl on a walk in a light jacket
response:
One day, a little girl went for a walk. She wore a light jacket because it was not cold. She saw pretty flowers and green trees. She felt happy.
As she walked, she saw a small rock. She did not see it and she stumbled. But she did not fall. She laughed and kept walking.
The little girl went home. She took off her light jacket and told her mom about her walk. Her mom hugged her and they ate yummy food. They had a good day.

instruction: Tell a story about a furry cat playing with a ball
response:
Once upon a time, there was a furry cat. The cat liked to play with a ball. The cat was very happy.
One day, the cat found a book. The book was called a novel. The cat did not know what a novel was, but it was fun to touch.
The cat liked to rub the novel with its paws. The cat rubbed the novel every day. The cat and the novel became best friends. And they lived happily ever after.

instruction: Write about a generous girl who thanks her parents
response: Once upon a time, there was a generous girl. Every day, she thanked her parents for all the good things they gave her. One day, the girl woke up feeling very excited. She thanked her parents for the wonderful surprise they had planned. But when the girl opened her eyes, she realized something was wrong. Her parents were gone and her room was empty. She felt so sad. The girl never thanked them for being so generous. She never got the chance to have a proper wake and say goodbye.

instruction: I want a story about a man who finds a cold little dog
response:
One day, a person named Tom went for a walk in the park. He saw a little dog. The dog was cold and started to tremble.
Tom said, "Oh no, little dog! You are cold! Let me help you." He picked up the dog and put it in his big, warm coat. The dog felt better and stopped trembling.
Tom was a little silly. He started to dance and sing with the dog in his coat. The dog liked it and wagged its tail. They were happy friends.

instruction: Write a story about a boy and his dad at an old stadium
response:
One day, a little boy named Tim went with his dad to an old stadium. The stadium was very big. Tim was excited to play there.
While playing, Tim saw a man stumble on a rock. The man fell down and was sad. Tim went to help the man stand up. Tim's dad was proud of him for helping.
The moral of the story is to always help others when they are in need.

instruction: Tell me about a humble farmer who grows wheat
response:
There was a humble farmer. He grew wheat on his farm. He had a big heart and loved his wheat very much.
One day, a little girl came to the farm. She asked the farmer if she could pick some wheat. The farmer was happy to permit her. The little girl picked the wheat and said thank you.
The humble farmer felt good. He knew he helped the little girl. The little girl went home with her wheat. She was happy too. And they all lived happily ever after.

instruction: Write about an elderly man who runs every day
response:
Once upon a time, there was an elderly man named Tom. Tom liked to run every day. He also had a whistle.
One day, Tom went for a run with his whistle. He ran fast and slow. The sun was bright and the sky was blue.
As Tom ran, he blew his whistle. The sound made the birds sing and the dogs bark. Tom was happy. He ran all day until it was time to go home.

instruction: I want a story about a cheerful girl who loves popcorn
response:
Once upon a time, there was a cheerful little girl named Sue. She loved to eat popcorn. One day, her mom made a big bowl of popcorn for her.
Sue was so happy to see the popcorn. She wanted to become the best popcorn maker in the world. She asked her mom to teach her how to make popcorn.
Sue and her mom made popcorn together. They had a lot of fun. Sue became very good at making popcorn. They shared the popcorn with everyone. Everyone was happy and cheerful.

instruction: Write a story about a boy and his mummy on a train
response:
Jack and Mommy were on the train. Mommy said, "Let's balance!"
Jack was so excited. He stretched his arms out, like an airplane.
Mommy said, "Look, Jack. Isn't that a pretty train?"
Jack looked out the window. He saw a bright red train. Jack said, "Wow, it's pretty!"
Jack and Mommy watched the pretty train go by. Then they started to balance again. They kept going until the train stopped.

instruction: Tell a story about a happy family in a cosy house
response:
Once upon a time there was a family, who lived happily in their cosy house.
Each day, the family would spend time together. One time, they decided to do something special.
So they went outside and joined a network of people who played together.
Everyone was able to do something useful while they were there, like helping each other and having fun.
When it was time to go home, everyone was happy and excited.
The family spent many more days together and had lots of happy memories.

instruction: Write about a boy who needs a haircut
response:
Once upon a time, there was a pale boy named Tim. Tim had very long hair. It was time for a haircut.
Tim's mom took him to the haircut place. He sat in a big chair. He had to lean back so the nice lady could cut his hair.
When the haircut was over, Tim looked in the mirror. He was so happy with his new haircut. He went home and showed his friends. They all liked Tim's haircut too. And they all played together in the sun.

instruction: I want a story about a clean park full of playing kids
response:
Once upon a time, there was a clean park. In the park, there were many kids playing. They were happy.
One day, a boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a big ice cream truck. Tim loved ice cream. He wanted to taste it.
Tim bought the ice cream and it was yummy. He shared it with his friends. They all loved the taste. They played more and went home. The end.

instruction: Write a story about a broken pencil that cannot draw
response:
Once upon a time, there was a pencil. The pencil was broken. It was sad because it could not draw.
One day, the broken pencil met a little girl. The girl saw the pencil and wanted to help it. She picked up the pencil and took it home. She put tape around the pencil to fix it.
The next day, the pencil became magic. It could draw anything the girl wanted. The girl and the pencil were very happy. They drew pictures all day long. And they all lived happily ever after.

instruction: Tell me about a red bird who loves to design
response:
Once upon a time, there was a red bird. The red bird loved to design. One day, the red bird wanted to make something new.
The red bird looked at the sky. The red bird saw a rainbow. The rainbow had many colors. The red bird wanted to design a rainbow too.
The red bird used red, blue, and yellow to make a rainbow. The red bird showed the rainbow to all its friends. The friends loved the red bird's rainbow. And they all lived happily ever after.

instruction: Write about a boy named Tim who plays with his ball
response:
Once upon a time, there was a player named Tim. Tim loved to play with his ball all day. He was very healthy because he played a lot.
One day, Tim saw a big hole in the ground. He wanted to prevent his ball from falling into the hole. So, he thought of a plan.
Tim found a big stick and covered the hole. Now, his ball could not fall in. Tim was happy and played all day with his ball. He stayed healthy and had lots of fun.

instruction: I want a story about a clumsy person by the sea
response: Once there was a clumsy person walking by the sea. The person got close to the edge of the water and the waves started to splash. The water was coming up higher and higher. The clumsy person slipped and tumbled in. Everyone shouted for help, but nobody could reach him in time. The currents of the water made the person disappear. Splash! He was gone.

instruction: Write a story about a brilliant painter
response:
Once upon a time, there was a painter. He liked to paint all day. He was a brilliant painter. People loved his work.
One day, the painter met a little girl. She did not understand his paintings. The painter felt sad. He wanted to make her happy.
Then, the painter made a new painting. It was a big heart. The little girl saw it and smiled. She understood the painting now. The painter learned that simple things can make people happy too. And they all lived happily ever after.

instruction: Tell a story about a blue rabbit in a small house
response:
Once upon a time, there was a blue rabbit. The blue rabbit lived in a small house. The rabbit loved to eat carrots.
One day, the blue rabbit found a big carrot. The carrot was stuck in the ground. The rabbit tried to pull the carrot, but it was very hard.
The rabbit had an idea. It decided to push the carrot from the other side. The blue rabbit pushed and pushed. At last, the carrot came out. The rabbit was very happy and ate the big carrot.

instruction: Write about a kind teacher and her class
response:
Once upon a time, there was a compassionate teacher. She loved her class very much. The class was full of little kids who liked to play and learn.
One day, the class was very loud. The kids were yelling and running around. The compassionate teacher wanted them to be quiet so they could learn.
The teacher said, "Please stop yelling, class." The kids heard her and stopped. They sat down and listened. The compassionate teacher was happy, and the class learned many new things.

instruction: I want a story about an angel with a broken toy car
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little angel. The angel had a toy car. The toy car was broken. The angel was sad.
One day, the angel's dad said he would repair the toy car. The angel was very happy and enthusiastic. They went to the garage to fix the toy car.
The angel and dad worked together. They repaired the toy car. The angel was so happy to play with the toy car again. They had a fun day playing together.

instruction: Write a story about a girl in a big scary storm
response:
One day a big storm came. It was very scary and had lots of lightning. A little girl named Sarah wanted to pick the lightning. She thought it would be fun.
So Sarah put on her raincoat and boots and went outside. But when she got close to the lightning, it was too big and too bright. The lightning scared Sarah and she tried to run away.
But it was too late. In a big flash, the lightning picked Sarah up and took her away. No one ever saw or heard from Sarah again.

instruction: Tell me about a swamp full of friendly animals
response:
Once upon a time, there was a swamp. In the swamp, there were many animals. They all have friends and play together.
One day, the swamp became icy. The animals were cold and could not play. They all have to stay in their homes.
A big sun came and made the icy swamp warm again. The animals could now have fun and play with their friends. They were happy in their swamp home.

instruction: Write about a woman jogging who finds a car
response: Jill was jogging down the street when she saw a car. She thought it looked interesting so she got closer to take a look. The car was bad. It had a lot of scratches and dents. Suddenly, she heard a loud noise and saw smoke coming out of the car. Jill started to run away, but it was too late. The car exploded! Jill was very scared and ran all the way home. She was very sad because the bad car had exploded.

instruction: I want a story about a jolly bunny who likes to hop
response:
Once upon a time, there was a jolly little bunny named Bob. Bob liked to hop and play all day. One day, while hopping, he saw a big hole.
Bob hopped closer to the hole and peeked inside. He saw a new friend, a tiny mouse named Tim. Tim was shy but wanted to play too.
"Hi, Tim! Want to play with me?" asked Bob. Tim smiled and said, "Yes, let's play!" They played all day and were very happy to meet each other.

instruction: Tell a story about a little green insect that jumps
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little insect. The insect was green and liked to jump. It lived in a dark garden with many big trees.
One day, the insect met a boy with a toy. The toy could record sounds. The boy said, "I want to record your jump sound!" The insect was happy to help.
They played together in the dark garden. The insect jumped, and the toy made a beep. The boy recorded the sound. They had fun and became good friends.

instruction: Write about a fish named Fin in the ocean
response:
One day, a little fish named Fin went to the ocean. Fin wanted to relax and play with his friends. The ocean was big and blue.
Fin met his friend, a crab named Red. Red said, "Hi Fin! Let's play near the dead tree!" Fin and Red went to the dead tree and played hide and seek. They had lots of fun.
After playing, Fin and Red sat near the ocean to relax. They talked and laughed. They had a great day at the ocean.

instruction: I want a story about a party for all the furry animals
response:
Once upon a time there was a furry party. All the animals were invited and they were having lots of fun. They were singing and dancing and playing games.
Suddenly a loud noise disturbed the party. All the animals stopped and looked around. What was that noise?
The noise was coming from a big, furry bear. It had come to join the party and the animals were very excited. They welcomed the bear with open arms and the party continued until late at night.

instruction: Write a story about a boy who finds something lucky
response:
Once upon a time, there was a player named Tim. Tim loved to play ball. One day, Tim found a lucky ball in his yard.
Tim wanted to improve his ball game. So, he played with the lucky ball every day. He threw the ball, he caught the ball, and he kicked the ball.
Soon, Tim got better and better at playing ball. He was very happy. Tim knew that with the lucky ball and lots of practice, he could be the best player. And they all lived happily ever after.

instruction: Tell me about an ugly frog who wants to visit a temple
response:
Once upon a time, there was an ugly frog. The frog wanted to go to the temple. He hopped and hopped to get there.
When the ugly frog got to the temple, he saw many kids playing. The kids saw the ugly frog and got scared. But the frog just wanted to play with them.
The ugly frog showed the kids how he could hop high and far. The kids laughed and played with the frog. They were all happy at the temple.

instruction: Write about a big red hen who lays eggs
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big, red hen. She had a unique job. She lay eggs for dinner. She lived on a farm with many friends.
One day, she lay a big, round egg. She was very happy. She told her friends, "Look! I lay a big egg for dinner!" Her friends were happy too.
At dinner, they all ate the egg. It was very yummy. They thanked the red hen for her unique egg. They all lived happily ever after.

instruction: I want a story about a very independent little girl
response:
Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sarah. Sarah was very independent. She loved to do everything on her own.
One day, Sarah was outside playing on her own. Suddenly, she heard a loud noise. It was so loud that it made her jump!
She looked around to find out where the sound came from. She saw a frog. The frog had slapped its big lung against the ground.
Sarah was amazed at how the frog was so independent. She smiled and said "Well done frog!"

instruction: Write a story about a mechanic whose car breaks down
response:
Once upon a time, there was a mechanic named Tom. Tom had a dull blue car. One day, his car stopped working. Tom was sad.
Tom's friend, Sam, came to help. Sam said, "I can fix your car, but you have to pay me." Tom said, "Okay, I will pay you."
Sam worked on the car. Tom waited. Soon, the car was fixed. Tom was happy. Tom paid Sam, and they both went for a ride in the dull blue car.

instruction: Tell a story about a lion who lost his metal toy
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big lion. The lion was troubled because he lost his metal toy. He looked for it everywhere. He was very sad.
One day, the lion heard a noise. It was a little mouse. The mouse found the metal toy. The lion was very happy. He said "thank you" to the mouse.
The lion and the mouse played with the metal toy. The lion roared with joy. They became good friends. They played together every day. And they were never troubled again.

instruction: Write about a girl who sees a big cloud in the sky
response: A girl was out walking in the park. She looked up at the sky and saw a big cloud. The cloud was very clean and white. Suddenly she realized something. She looked around and she noticed that the park was also very clean. She ran around the park picking up all the rubbish she could find. After she had finished, she stood in the park and looked up at the sky. The cloud was still there. She smiled and thought, "The park looks better now that it is clean, just like the cloud!".

instruction: I want a story about a pale king and his pet
response:
Once upon a time, there was a pale king. He lived in a big castle. The king had a pet. The pet was a frog. The frog liked to hop.
One day, the frog went for a hop. It hopped and hopped. It hopped far away from the castle. The frog got lost. The pale king was sad.
The king looked for the frog. He looked near the castle. He looked far from the castle. But he could not find the frog. The king stayed sad. The end.

instruction: Write a story about a town that has an earthquake
response:
Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big earthquake. People were scared. They did not know what to do.
A kind man named Tom wanted to help. He had a plan to release big balloons into the sky. The balloons would make everyone feel fine.
Tom released the balloons and people looked up. They saw the pretty colors and felt fine. The earthquake was over and everyone was happy. The town was safe again, thanks to Tom and his balloons.

instruction: Tell me about a girl named Lily who loves to cook
response:
Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to cook. One day, she wanted to cook a chicken for her family.
Lily went to the store and found a flexible chicken. She was happy. She took the chicken home to cook it for dinner.
At home, Lily's mom asked, "What are you cooking?" Lily said, "I am cooking a flexible chicken for dinner!" They cooked the chicken together and had a yummy dinner.

instruction: Write about a fragile bird living in a small nest
response:
Once upon a time, there was a fragile bird named Will. Will lived in a small nest up in a tree. One day, it was very cold outside, and Will started to shiver.
A big, mean cat saw Will shiver in the tree. The cat wanted to catch Will and make him stop shivering. The cat climbed the tree and tried to get Will.
Will was scared and tried to fly away, but the mean cat was fast. The cat caught Will and made him stop shivering. The end.

instruction: I want a story about a big boat with an anchor
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big boat. The boat had a big anchor. The boat went to a pretty island. The people on the boat were happy.
The people on the boat wanted to play on the island. They had to unpack their toys. They had harmless toys like balls and dolls. They played all day and had fun.
When it was time to go home, they packed their toys. They lifted the anchor and sailed away. They waved goodbye to the pretty island. They had a great day.

instruction: Write a story about a hairy dog who goes to the store
response:
One day, a big, hairy dog went to the store. He had a long shadow. The dog wanted to buy a toy. He walked and walked in the store.
Then, the dog saw a cat. The cat was funny. The cat had a short shadow. The cat wanted to play with the dog. They played in the store.
But, the dog's shadow was not a shadow! It was a big, black blanket. The cat and the dog were happy. They played with the blanket and had fun.

instruction: Tell a story about an old tree with a broken branch
response:
Once upon a time, there was an old tree. The old tree had a broken branch. Two birds lived on the branch. They were friends.
One day, the birds had a quarrel. They did not want to share the branch anymore. They were mad at each other. The old tree was sad.
The old tree asked the sun for help. The sun shone brightly and made the broken branch warm. The birds felt happy again. They stopped their quarrel and became friends again. The old tree was happy too.

instruction: Write about a team of friends who play together
response:
Once upon a time, there was a team of friends. They loved to play together. They were very good at working together. They were a successful team.
One day, they saw a big monster. The monster wanted to fight. The team was scared, but they knew they had to be brave.
The friends worked together and fought the monster. They were strong and smart. In the end, the team won. They were happy and safe. They were a successful team who could do anything together.

instruction: I want a story about a cool cat who sees a wreck
response:
One day, a cool cat named Tim went for a walk. He saw a big wreck on the road. It was a mess. Tim wanted to help.
Tim started to scatter the broken things away from the road. He worked hard. Soon, the road was clean. Tim felt happy.
A little girl saw Tim and said, "Thank you, Tim, for cleaning the wreck!" Tim smiled and said, "You're welcome. I like to help." They became friends and played together.

instruction: Write a story about two best friends called Tom and Sally
response: Once upon a time, there were two best friends: Tom and Sally. They were always very happy together. One day, Tom and Sally were playing with their favorite toy, a chess set. They loved zooming the little chess pieces around the board. Soon, it was time for them to go home. They said goodbye, but promised to play chess on the board again soon. They were so happy when they hugged each other goodbye. They zoomed off to their homes, looking forward to the next time they could play chess together again.

instruction: Tell me about a boy who wants to become very smart
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim wanted to become very smart. He asked his mom for a tutor to help him learn.
The tutor came to Tim's house every day. They read books and played learning games. Tim was happy and the tutor was nice. They had fun together.
One day, the tutor didn't come. Tim waited and waited, but the tutor never came back. Tim was sad and cried. He didn't become smart like he wanted to.

instruction: Write about an elderly lady with a long cord
response:
Once upon a time, there was an elderly lady named Sue. She had a long cord in her house. Sue liked to pretend with the cord.
One day, Sue took the cord and pretended it was a big snake. She made the cord snake wiggle and dance. Sue had lots of fun with her pretend snake.
The next day, Sue used the cord to pretend it was a jump rope. She played and jumped with the cord all day. Sue loved to pretend with her cord and have fun.

instruction: I want a story about a cat who plays with a cable
response:
One day, a happy cat named Tom found a cable. He liked to play with the cable. Tom would run and jump with the cable in his mouth.
Tom's friend, a dog named Max, saw him playing. Max wanted to play with the cable too. "Can I play with the cable?" Max asked. Tom said, "Yes, we can play together."
They played with the cable all day. They did not complain. They were happy to share and play. They were good friends who liked to have fun.

instruction: Write a story about a boy who loves to wander
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved to wander.
His name was Tommy and he was very excited.
Yesterday, he decided to wander around his backyard. He looked at rocks and plants that were in his backyard. He even spotted a ladybug crawling on a flower! 
Tommy was so excited that he decided to start exploring more. He crawled into a bush and found some colorful eggs. 
Tommy had a lot of fun exploring in his backyard and was very happy. He had the best day yesterday!

instruction: Tell a story about a grumpy old man in a small house
response:
Once upon a time, there was a grumpy old man. He lived in a small house. The house was not pretty. The man wanted to make it pretty.
One day, the grumpy man found a can of gold paint. He had an idea. He would paint the house. The house would be pretty with gold paint.
The grumpy man painted the house. It took a long time. When he finished, the house was very pretty. The man was not grumpy anymore. He was happy.

instruction: Write about a mechanic who fixes cars all day
response:
Once upon a time, there was a nice man named Tom. Tom was a mechanic. He fixed cars all day and loved his job.
One day, a lady came to Tom with a broken car. Tom looked at the car and knew what to do. He fixed the car very fast. The lady was so happy!
The lady wanted to thank Tom. She gave him money to pay for his help. Tom was happy too. He used the money to buy ice cream for his family. Everyone loved the nice mechanic Tom.

instruction: I want a story about a white trumpet that makes a nice noise
response:
Once upon a time, there was a white trumpet. It made a noise people liked to hear.
One day, the trumpet blew in the wind and got stuck in a tree. It couldn't come down.
Suddenly, a brave guy came to rescue the trumpet. He climbed the tree and was able to get the trumpet down.
The trumpet was so happy! It stopped blowing in the wind and started to make music for everyone to enjoy.
The brave guy was a hero! He rescued the white trumpet and made everyone smile.

instruction: Write a story about a girl who finds a unique flower
response:
One day, a girl named Sue went on a walk. She saw a pretty flower. The flower was unique. It was big and pink. Sue liked the flower a lot.
Then, a bee appeared. The bee liked the flower too. It made perfume from the flower. The perfume smelled nice. Sue and the bee were happy.
Sue and the bee became friends. They played near the flower every day. They loved the unique flower and its perfume. They were very happy together.

instruction: Tell me about a restless pony who runs around
response: Once upon a time there was a pony. He was a restless pony and was always running around. One day he started running and he didn't slow down. He ran so fast that he ran right into a tree and SNAP! He broke his leg. He was so sad that he couldn't keep running around. He had to rest, but he was too restless to stay in one spot. That was the bad ending to the story of the restless pony.

instruction: Write about a leopard who loves to sail
response:
Once upon a time, there was a popular leopard. He loved to sail on a big boat. He had many friends who liked to sail too.
One sunny day, the leopard and his friends went to sail on the blue sea. They saw fish, birds, and other animals. They all played and laughed together.
As the sun began to set, the leopard and his friends sailed back home. They were happy and tired. They all agreed it was the best day ever.

instruction: I want a story about a white alligator in a pond
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big alligator. He lived in a pond. The alligator was white. His name was Al. Al was a happy alligator.
One day, Al wanted to relax. He went to the soft grass near the pond. He lay down on the grass. The sun was warm and bright. Al felt good.
Soon, Al saw a little bird. The bird was blue. The bird sang a pretty song. Al liked the song. The bird and Al became friends. They relaxed together in the sun.

instruction: Write a story about a green frog who loves pizza
response:
Once upon a time, there was a green frog. The frog loved to eat pizza. One day, he found a big pizza in the park.
The frog was very happy. He wanted to stay and eat the pizza. But his mom said, "No, don't stay. We have to go home." The frog did not listen to his mom.
He stayed and ate the pizza. But the pizza was bad. The green frog got sick. He was sad and wished he had listened to his mom.

instruction: Tell a story about an adventurous girl who plays outside
response:
Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lucy. She was very adventurous. Lucy loved to play outside with her friends.
One day, Lucy's mommy and daddy told her they were going to a marriage. Lucy was so excite! She put on her pretty dress and her shiny shoes.
At the marriage, Lucy danced and laughed with her friends. They played fun games and ate yummy cake. It was a happy day for everyone.

instruction: Write about an angry monkey who finds a whip
response:
One day an angry monkey had a idea to settle a problem. He found a whip lying on the ground and decided to use it. He quickly went around, swinging the whip hard, until everyone was settled. All the animals in the zoo were happy again, and the monkey felt good.
But soon the angry monkey had to go home. He said goodbye to his friends and left the zoo happy. He went home and settled right in. The whip went back on the ground and the monkey was content.

instruction: I want a story about a nervous whale
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big whale. The whale was nervous. He was scared because he did something bad.
One day, the whale ate a lot of fish. He ate too many fish. He began to feel bad. The whale knew he made a mistake. He felt regret.
The whale wanted to say sorry to the fish. He promised to be a good friend from now on. The fish forgave the whale, and they all played together. The whale was happy and not nervous anymore.

instruction: Write a story about a thin cat who wears a red hat
response:
Once upon a time, there was a thin cat named Tom. Tom liked to wear a red hat. He lived in a house made of bricks.
One day, Tom saw a big dog near his brick house. The dog wanted to play. Tom was scared, but he put on his red hat and went outside.
Tom and the dog played all day. They ran and jumped, and Tom's red hat stayed on. They became good friends. Tom learned that even a thin cat can be brave when he wears his favorite hat.
